data.body:
Guard evidence: each test FAILS (not merely slows) when its seam regresses.

Seeding `sleep_fn=time.sleep` / `sleeper: Callable[[float], None] = time.sleep` back into the two signatures, then running the two enclosing modules:

    E       AssertionError: expected five 5s logical delays, got []
    tests/scripts/bridge/test_jira_capability_probe.py:308: AssertionError
    E       AssertionError: expected 5s then 10s logical delays, got []
    tests/scripts/test_dependency_audit.py:333: AssertionError
    FAILED tests/scripts/bridge/test_jira_capability_probe.py::test_probe_retries_jql_search_three_times
    FAILED tests/scripts/test_dependency_audit.py::test_gate_reports_db_unreachable_as_infrastructure

The recorder stays empty when the seam is bound early, so the schedule assertion fails loudly instead of the test quietly going slow again. Seeds reverted; `git diff --stat` shows only the five intended files.

Production behaviour proven unchanged. With NOTHING passed, and `time.sleep` patched only AFTER import:

    access_check.run_access_check sleep_fn default: <function _retry_sleep>
    dependency_audit.run_pip_audit sleeper default: <function _retry_sleep>
    run_pip_audit with NO sleeper resolved to the live time.sleep: True [5, 10]
    production error text unchanged: advisory DB unreachable after 3 attempts: connection timed out reaching osv.dev

Retry counts, delay schedule, printed progress lines, error text and exception types are all identical; the only change is WHEN `time.sleep` is resolved.

Gates: 12 `check_*` scripts pass; `check_complexity_baseline --check` `active=59 new=0 increased=0 stale=0`; `make lint` and `make typecheck` clean (519 files); generators re-run with no diff.
